results.evidence: "Recommendation: Use TypeScript" ... "TypeScript is the preferred choice for production-quality MCP servers"

results.expectation: Recommends streamable HTTP as the transport for the remote server and specifies stateless JSON as opposed to stateful sessions/streaming responses

results.expectation: Distinguishes that stdio is the transport for local servers (remote = streamable HTTP, local = stdio)
results.evidence: "Use stdio transport only for local/embedded servers running on the same machine as the client. Since your server is remote, streamable HTTP is the correct choice."
